minimumEvidenceQuestion: After official-anchor search exhaustion, can a same-subject Xiaohongshu wide view show a locatable Xinhua Road or Panyu Road street interface plus at least two stable cinema-boundary controls, so it can be compared with the existing OSM compound without treating a perspective photograph as a survey plan?

searchPlan.queryOrder: Run groups sequentially. Add no synonym until the immediately preceding group has no verified same-subject wide result. Stop early if all required view categories are satisfied.

humanPace.scrollPolicy: one deliberate scroll at a time; wait for visible content before another action
humanPace.challengeStopLine: Stop immediately on rate limit, verification, challenge, login prompt or unusual-access warning; record only the visible stop condition and do not retry, circumvent or switch automation.

minimumVisibleFacts: readable or uniquely locatable Xinhua Road or Panyu Road context
cinema facade or plaza edge in the same wide frame
two non-coincident stable controls belonging to Shanghai Cinema
examples: entrance center, main-ribbon end, tower corner, site-wall corner
both controls must be sufficiently visible to compare against OSM context
road-side direction not contradicted by the known compound
post-level location/context or a reproducible street cue
enough wide context to distinguish cinema compound from adjacent film-art-center or streetscape
no claim that the photograph alone supplies north arrow, scale or a solved transform

acceptable: original post photo or video frame with provable same-subject wide street context
carousel image whose post-level location/context identifies Shanghai Cinema
oblique or side view that jointly shows a road edge and two cinema-boundary controls
notSufficient: front-only facade duplicate without curb, sidewalk or locatable road context
cropped ribbon, signage, lobby or decorative-detail close-up
AI-generated, collage, map screenshot, or untraceable repost
perspective photo offered as a replacement for a surveyed plan, north arrow or scale
Shanghai Film Art Center, CHAO hotel, Xinhua Road streetscape or Panyu Road image without a provable Shanghai Cinema subject
single address, POI pin, OSM centroid or one weak subject control
mediaClassification.captureRule: Before inference, record post URL/identifier, displayed author handle, displayed date, query used, media type, exact image/frame index, and observed facts. Retain original media read-only; never overwrite or delete an earlier capture.

observed: Official restricted search is exhausted without a public site plan containing north arrow, scale or dimensions and two georeferenced subject controls.
The accepted Hero, Hybrid Identity and Massing binaries, all three MCP gates, and Three.js three-tier records already pass and must not be redone.
Current regular GLB envelope is too far from Xinhua Road and too close to Panyu Road, while a single translation cannot solve plaza, ribbon and steps together.
inferred: A verified wide social post may reduce uncertainty about street interface and local boundary correspondence, but cannot independently authorize a placement transform.
unknown: WGS84 locations of the Hero pivot, entrance center and ribbon endpoint.
Authoritative post-renovation relation between wall or entrance geometry and OSM outline.
Whether any result can provide enough locatable context to supplement, but not replace, formal survey evidence.

rawMediaRetention.policy: Original media is read-only; never overwrite or delete an earlier capture.
rawMediaRetention.currentAction: No directory or media is created by this preparation commit.

rejectionAndDisposition.reasonableSearchMissDefinition: All four query groups are attempted at the stated human pace, no more than 24 results total are deliberately reviewed, and no verified result satisfies every required same-subject category after duplicate and adjacent-site rejection.
rejectionAndDisposition.beforeMainWindowConfirmation: No runtime-disable candidate, registry edit, runtime edit, model change, map/road/collision change or map acceptance is authorized.
rejectionAndDisposition.afterMainWindowConfirmation: Only after the main window records an exhaustive reasonable miss may it propose a runtime-disable candidate for this asset. A disable may remove the asset only from registry/runtime; all GLB, Blend, generator, evidence, test artifacts and Recovery/Hold materials remain permanently preserved.
